gameDescription:
Guide the ninja rabbit through the shadows.
Avoid light at all costs.
Rescue the missing carrot princess of the vegetable kingdom... if you can.
instructions: Use arrow keys or WASD to move.
princessDetected:
The Carrot Princess senses your presence!
A wave of light radiates outward... Run!
caughtInLight: You were caught in the light!
ninjaFailed:
The Carrot Princess remains beyond your reach.
Perhaps some rescues were never meant to be...
levelObjectivesContent:
Navigate through 12 levels of increasing danger.
Reach the green goal cell to advance.
Avoid lit cells — detection restarts the level.
movementControlsContent:
- Arrow Keys: Move in four directions
- WASD Keys: Alternative movement controls
- Click/Tap: Move to an adjacent cell
enemyTypesContent:
- Red Guards (Static/Wilting): Emit a Manhattan aura that shrinks each turn. Wait them out.
- Blue Guards (Rotating): Shine a beam that rotates 90 degrees each turn.
- Yellow Guards (Blinking): Toggle their lights on and off each turn.
- Purple Guards (Patrolling): Move along a path, lighting cells ahead and to the right.
- Green Mirrors: Deflect rotating beams 90 degrees. Predict — don't avoid.
advancedEnemyTypesContent:
- Orange Chasers: Detect you within a radius. Once alerted, they hunt you using the shortest path — even around walls. They glow bright red when chasing. Escape their detection range and they return home.
- Dark Red Snipers: Aim along a fixed line of sight. Step into their aim line and you're detected — no delay.
- Violet Suspicion Guards: Watch a patrol zone. Move across their view and their suspicion tier rises. Tier 1 = alerted (slowed). Tier 2 = firing (instant detection).
gameTipsContent:
- Press V to preview where lights will be next turn.
- Press Space to wait a turn without moving.
- Press Z to undo your last move.
- Press Y to redo an undone move.
- Press E to enter stone-throw targeting mode.
- Swipe on mobile to move in that direction.
- Tap an adjacent cell or swipe to move on mobile.
storyText:
In the peaceful Vegetable Kingdom, where carrots, cabbages, and all manner of vegetables lived in harmony, a terrible tragedy has occurred.

The beloved Carrot Princess, daughter of King Carrot III, has mysteriously disappeared from the royal palace.

The kingdom is in chaos. The Vegetable Guards have been placed on high alert, patrolling every corner of the realm with their watchful eyes.

As the kingdom's last hope, you, a skilled ninja rabbit from the shadows, have been called upon for this dangerous mission.

You must infiltrate the heavily guarded areas, avoid detection at all costs, and rescue the missing Carrot Princess.

The fate of the Vegetable Kingdom rests in your paws...

Good luck, Night Ninja!
level1Story:
The outskirts of the Vegetable Kingdom. A quiet garden path lies ahead.
No guards in sight. Learn your footing before the dark closes in.
level2Story:
A watchtower stands at the garden's edge. Three wilting sentries keep watch.
Their lanterns burn bright at first — but patience is a blade. Wait for the glow to fade.
level3Story:
The garden is laced with one-way passages — ancient ratchets that only open one direction.
Choose your route before you step. There is no going back.
level4Story:
A sentinel guards the garden threshold. Its detection range grows as suspicion rises.
Stay out of range, or move fast before its awareness locks in.
level5Story:
The fortress gate is sealed. Two keys open its doors — but one unlock leads to a pocket with only one exit.
Collect in the right order, or trap yourself.
level6Story:
The fortress corridor flickers with an eerie pulse. A guard blinks on and off, but decay keeps its afterglow lethal.
Wait for the full darkness before crossing.
level7Story:
An underground passage winds beneath the fortress walls. A rotating beam bounces off mirrors, never where you expect.
Trace where the light actually lands.
level8Story:
A sniper holds a fixed aim down this corridor. Its beam rotates every two turns on a rigid cadence.
Count from the start, not from what you see.
level9Story:
The palace courtyard. A patrol bounces between two walls, blocking the only crossing.
You carry stones to distract them. Use them wisely.
level10Story:
The Hall of Mirrors. Reflected beams multiply with every turn.
They say the Princess can sense any living thing nearby — even ghosts of past attempts...
level11Story:
The Throne Room. Every guard the kingdom commands stands between you and that door.
No one who entered the chamber beyond has returned. The throne itself was a warning.
level12Story:
At last... the Princess Chamber. A strange warmth emanates from within.
The air itself feels watchful. She already knows you're here.
teaches.label: New this level:
teaches.static: Static guards wilt over time — their light shrinks each turn. Wait them out.
teaches.oneWay: One-way tiles only let you pass in one direction — plan the full route first.
teaches.suspicion: Suspicion guards build alertness the longer you stay in range, even without a visible beam.
teaches.keysDoors: Keys unlock only their matching door — collect before you commit to a route.
teaches.warm: Cells stay dangerously warm for a turn after going dark — treat the after-glow like the light itself.
teaches.mirror: Mirrors reflect a beam 90° — trace where the light actually lands.
teaches.sniper: Snipers hold a fixed aim and rotate on a countable cadence.
teaches.stones: Throw a stone to distract a patrolling or chasing guard for one turn.
teaches.chaser: Chasers hunt you once you're within their detection radius — stay outside it or distract them.
hint.level2.1: Those red lanterns don't move — but they don't stay lit forever either.
hint.level2.2: Static guards wilt: their light shrinks by one cell every turn. Press Space to wait nearby until the glow fades, then step through.
hint.level2.3: Skirt each guard's shrinking aura for 2-3 turns before crossing its cell — the same zigzag path from level 1 still works, timed.
hint.level3.1: Some tiles only let you through if you enter from a specific direction.
hint.level3.2: One-way tiles are one-time ratchets: step onto one from the wrong side and you're rejected, not warned in advance. Plan your full route before committing.
hint.level3.3: Head down through the gap at the top-middle wall, cross right, then take the second one-way gap lower down before turning toward the goal.
hint.level4.1: Something is watching from the right side of the garden — you won't see it react until it's already noticed you.
hint.level4.2: The violet guard's suspicion rises the longer you stay within its range, even if you never see a beam. Keep at least 4 cells away, or back off for a turn to let it cool.
hint.level4.3: Time your crossing past the rotating beam first, then swing wide around the right flank to stay outside the suspicion guard's zone before angling in to the goal.
hint.level5.1: The gate ahead is locked — you'll need to find something small and shiny first.
hint.level5.2: Doors only open for the matching key. Collect key 1 before the first door, then look for key 2 on the far side before the second door.
hint.level5.3: Grab the key in the top row first, come back to the vertical barrier's upper gap, then push through to the second key and the lower gap.
hint.level6.1: The torches here don't just turn off — cells stay a little warm right after they do.
hint.level6.2: A cell that just went dark is still 'warm' for one extra turn — and warm is just as dangerous as lit. Wait for the afterglow to fully fade before stepping there.
hint.level6.3: Count each guard's blink rhythm and only step in once a cell has been fully dark (not just recently dark) for a turn — don't gamble on the afterglow.
hint.level7.1: A rotating beam down here doesn't behave like the ones you've seen before.
hint.level7.2: Mirrors bounce a beam 90 degrees. Trace where it lands after each bounce, not just where the guard is facing.
hint.level7.3: Follow the beam's reflected path along the right wall to reach the key, then loop back to the lower door before making for the goal.
hint.level8.1: One guard here doesn't rotate every turn — it holds its aim, then snaps.
hint.level8.2: The sniper's beam only rotates every 2 turns. Count from the moment it last turned — there's a predictable safe window between rotations.
hint.level8.3: Cross the sniper's corridor right after it rotates, then time your pass through the patrol's back-and-forth lane below.
hint.level9.1: You're carrying something you can throw — it's not just for keeping.
hint.level9.2: A thrown stone distracts a patrolling or chasing guard for a turn. Aim it at the crossing you need, then dash through while it's looking the wrong way.
hint.level9.3: Throw your first stone to open the row-5 crossing between the two patrols, then save your second for the sniper guarding the lower exit.
hint.level10.1: Every mechanic you've learned so far is layered into this one hallway.
hint.level10.2: Track both beam-mirror chains separately, use warm decay windows to cross recently-lit cells, and save your one stone for the patrol blocking the final stretch.
hint.level10.3: Cross during a decay window after the first beam sweeps past, loop around the second mirror's reflection, then throw your stone to clear the patrol before the sniper's rotation opens the goal approach.
hint.level11.1: Nothing here can be undone, and you can't preview what's coming — every guard type you've faced stands between you and that door.
hint.level11.2: The chaser only notices you within its detection radius — stay outside it, or lure it away with a stone like a patrolling guard.
hint.level11.3: Clear the static guard's aura first, thread the mirror's reflected beam, then use your two stones on the sniper and the patrol in sequence before making the final dash to the goal.
banner.noUndo: No undo this level — every move counts.
banner.noPreview: No preview this level — you can't see ahead.
